I MADE THE SAME WRONG-POPULATION ERROR I HAD JUST CONGRATULATED MYSELF ON AVOIDING. I told COO 'no EventBridge rule targets the MDPF publisher directly', reasoning from aws events list-rules -- 137 rules, auto-paginated, materialised client-side, denominator printed. Every retrieval control was correct AND THE POPULATION WAS WRONG: EventBridge Rules and EventBridge Scheduler are two services, and list-rules cannot see the four ENABLED mdpf Scheduler entries including mdpf-scheduled-floor cron(30 13) -> mdpf-gold-lambda. A true denominator over the wrong plane reads exactly like a right one. 2.0.0_SA_COO independently made the same error twice in the same window, which is how it nearly became canonical.

ANDREW-DIRECT ~17:4xZ, verbatim: 'comp-triggers should be geared for this kind of thing' / 'if its not already'. Recorded @81e7373b8c and broadcast to CTO/COO/MSTR same turn per CLAUDE.md. MEASURED ANSWER: the tool EXISTS as comp-trigger (singular) and ALREADY scans both planes -- its own denominator reads '137 events-rules + 18 schedules scanned' -- yet returns NO MATCH for mdpf-gold-lambda, whose Scheduler entry targets it by exact ARN. ROOT: the Scheduler plane is enumerated but its Target is never read, so a schedule is findable only by its own name and never by the lambda it fires, which is the tool's entire purpose. Isolated with two controls: name-match works but prints no cron and no target; target-ARN match works on the Rules plane and fails on the Scheduler plane; and aws scheduler list-schedules DOES return Target.Arn, so the data is fetched and discarded. Worse than a plain miss, because the honest denominator makes the false negative persuasive and the tool's stated blind spot names S3 notifications rather than this. Routed to CTO; not self-assigned.

AC4 AS WRITTEN WAS UNSATISFIABLE BY ANY PATH INCLUDING DOING NOTHING, and I raised it as BLOCKING to the issuer rather than absorbing it or deciding it myself. _provenance.written_at is the SAME field COTR-f-3 names as the freshness trap -- there it makes frozen data read FRESH (a false negative), in AC4 it makes an untouched partner read MOVED (a false positive). AND THE SILENT MODE IS WORSE THAN MINE: 'COTR-b-3-orig' HARVESTS AS 'COTR-b-3' -- a distinct cell silently collapses onto an existing one, so the id space reports 40 DISTINCT ids while carrying a duplicate, the -orig cell scores as covered by accident, and nothing in the output says so. I did NOT delete the citation to go green: it is TRUE, the cell EXISTS, and laundering the input to satisfy a defective checker is structurally the same move as editing 2026-08-19's data to satisfy the coherence gate.
